# Zynergy Labs

> Zynergy Labs builds Forager, a private foraging companion for Android. Record your walks, log your finds, works offline.

Forager is free on Google Play. It has no ads and no in-app purchases. It runs on Android phones with Android 8.0 or later. There is no account and no sign-in. What you record stays on your phone: tracks, finds, photos, waypoints and trips. None of it is uploaded.

Forager does not identify species, and it cannot tell you whether anything is safe to eat.

Map downloads cover the continental United States.

## Forager

- [Forager](https://zynergy-labs.com/Forager/): what Forager is, the problem it solves, its features, and answers to common questions.
- [Get it on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zynergylabs.forager.app): the app's listing.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://zynergy-labs.com/privacy/): what stays on your phone, what is sent while you are online, and to whom.
- [Deleting your Forager data](https://zynergy-labs.com/delete-data/): delete any item in the app, or uninstall Forager to remove everything.
